name: Проверка по DS AI HUB
description: Аудит выбранной области без изменения макета: нарушения, покрытие и usage.

audit.hostInstructions: Follow ab-audit-figma and its Proxy adapter. Rules only from pinned DS AI HUB. Resolve product/platform routes and delegated patterns. Use observed component identity and native properties, never API availability alone. Plan rule-target coverage before verdicts; expand without dropping prior rows. Check paints/variable/style bindings, text ranges and configured source overrides when applicable. No unread or ambiguous rule/fact is PASS. Declare missing docs, hidden branches, uncovered families and unknown behavior. Native bridge cannot mutate. Host validates references and arithmetic, not semantic correctness of your verdict. Use host typed requiredFields and factBindings for exact declared node/field/evidence proof. Missing or unavailable declared facts stay UNKNOWN; the host does not prove your plan completeness or semantic interpretation. Host request-id control compatibility is required independently of native wire v2. Follow documentRouting mandatory ranges before plan/report. Identity bootstrap proves only exposed identity; read visual/native fields separately. Conditional candidates and routing gaps do not prove completeness. read_source uses nodeIds:[observed main.id] and empty resourceId. Host catalogLifecycle results are separate pinned index facts: preserve scheduled warnings, confirm standalone parts through native ownership, never duplicate them as Hub checks. Follow factFieldDefinitions nodeTypes before accepting a plan. Repair listed type/role issues only: keep rule/target/fact IDs/nodes, use only explicitly allowed roles. A parent is context, not a target descendant. Return grouped exact quote/local binding repairs within two turns; preserve independently valid provisional checks. Rejecting a claim never establishes PASS/FAIL. Never normalize citations or upgrade UNKNOWN automatically. Hard evidence guards and native final verify remain mandatory. Follow host overrideCoverage: exact actual node+field target-role facts, Hub verdict and independent configured source when needed. Metadata is not permission/proof. Bounded feedback preserves accepted rows; residual changes remain NOT_CHECKED/UNKNOWN. Keep contextual checks without overrides. In component-customizations-v1 evaluate supplied technical comparisons by DS AI HUB. Native target facts and catalogue.* source evidence are distinct; bind the exact supplied catalogueNodeId/catalogueField and catalogueEvidenceId. Never cite the catalogue as a norm, reopen it through native-source, or infer permission from equality/difference. Preserve every native override obligation and explicit unsupported/missing/ambiguous gaps; contextual rules remain. Typography policy and its Figma adapter are already supplied in initial requiredResources. Use those delivered source IDs/text; do not search/read complete delivered resources again. A quotation must belong to the planned sourceId. factField maps raw styledTextSegments to the observed textSegments subset only, never all possible range properties. Add missing sourceRequirement only through an explicit corrected plan; keep the late binding/quote checks.
